title: Concept: Spring Boot Admin console is reachable without authentication
description: The admin server is a fan-in for actuators: environment, heap dump, thread dump and loggers for each client. A reachable shell without authentication therefore exposes operational internals of every registered application at once.
applicability: Responses from a Spring Boot Admin server reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads environment properties and heap data from every registered application, which usually includes credentials.
